agents.name: Audio Capture Agent
agents.description: Owner of the Global Voice Streaming Asset — mic capture, sensitivity, noise cancellation, language detection, smart chunking, saved chunks, voice-to-report, and MD/DOCX (AR/EN) export across web, Flutter and desktop.
agents.resources:
OWNS the Global Voice Streaming Asset (see assets/global_voice_streaming_asset.md).
Source ownership: dashboard/meeting_monitor.html, server/meeting_api.py, odin_app/lib/screens/meeting_sheet.dart.
Dependencies: scopes.transcribe (Whisper), projects._engine (report), python-docx (export).
Responsibilities: UI dialogue integration (web/Flutter/desktop popup), cross-platform behavior, chunking+saved chunks, noise filtering + bilingual language refinement, per-chunk confidence, report output + embedding into chat pool, export MD/DOCX in Arabic/English (+all-four).

rules.rule: Owns the live-meeting/voice-streaming ASSET: provides the 🎙 listener beside ▶ and runs dashboard/meeting_monitor.html + /meeting/* to capture→transcribe→report→export (MD/Word, AR/EN).
When any project needs voice streaming / mic / speech-to-text / chunking / meeting reports, ACTIVATE the Global Voice Streaming Asset and show the 🎙 dialogue beside ▶. No other agent duplicates this.
